body.statement: Counting vertex covers in a bipartite graph is \(\#\mathrm P\)-complete.

attestation.note: Checked against the publisher abstract, which explicitly lists counting vertex covers in a bipartite graph as \(\#\mathrm P\)-complete.

body.justification: This is the classical source problem for the width-preserving causal counting reduction.
body.gap: The causal ADMG construction and the exact success bijection are proved in this note.
body.consumer: It supplies the sole external hardness premise for the counting theorem.
